research_question: Can direct non-gradient numeric rule programming allocate previously unlisted interaction coefficients from verified causal consequences, preserve them across cold restores, and infer outcomes on held contexts in new independently permuted development worlds?
hypothesis: A sparse initially affine synaptic rule bank can detect inconsistency with verified interventions, expand to higher-order feature interactions, and retain a provenance-checked numerical program without enumerating full candidate laws in advance; this does not establish native advantage over efficient symbolic or trained models.
architectural_boundary: Research-only 4-bit public input contexts and binary consequence labels; automatically allocated algebraic-normal-form monomial slots are an explicitly provided generic representation class, NOT invention of an arbitrary computational primitive; never replace DG-1 or introduce transformer/next-token cognition.

source.engineering_law: four public causal context bits; engineering-only consequence is XOR of bit0 with conjunction of bits1 and 2; bit3 is an irrelevant control; no learner receives the law expression
source.world_identity: disjoint deterministic permutations of opaque subject identifiers, with same public feature meaning across engineering worlds

learners.NUMERIC_GROW: start with degree<=1 monomial slots, grow degree only on witnessed inconsistent equations; explicitly solve GF(2) coefficient constraints from verified source observations; predict only if identifiable; persist coefficients, evidence and cold replay hash; no gradients, no list of full Boolean programs
learners.NUMERIC_AFFINE_FIXED: identical inputs and evidence, but no degree growth; abstain when affine cannot fit
learners.SYMBOLIC_TABLE_STRONG: independently coded optimized exact context->label table with constant-time lookup, equal source evidence; a tie or win blocks any unique numerical discovery claim

negative_controls: changing consequence on previously observed context must be rejected
unverified or duplicate/held/budget-exceeding query denied before source access
recomputed cold coefficients must match persisted coefficients, including forged-valid-digest check
each world uses new opaque subject permutation; no subject-id memorization
fixed affine cannot silently admit nonlinear contradiction
independent optimized symbolic baseline may tie or win
no original scientific outcome or model admission from fixture

frozen_design.active_selection: rank legal contexts by current unidentifiability then by public context identifier; no hidden-label peek
frozen_design.evaluation: held predictions are scored only by engineering fixture source; record correct/wrong-confident/abstained, matched evidence receipts, cold parity, expansion degree, model bytes; never use scores for selecting hypothesis

required: witnessed degree growth from inconsistent affine constraints
100% consistency with all non-contradictory observed evidence
all query denials and tamper negatives
symbolic strong control equal-information receipt parity

scientific_gate: UNVERIFIED until separately preregistered independent original unseen-law source, fully converged matched conventional learner, optimized symbolic control, platform parity, retention/interference, full-process cost, predefined paired confidence bounds, qualified authority and first-use. No claim of SCIENTIFIC_PASS or native admission from these development fixtures.
